2026-10-30: run 298f834e-66e0-4be9-8907-f56611d9b70c through the app API on the Local ComfyUI worker (ComfyUI 0.37.0 started with --cpu, so no GPU was used), workflow hash d2b357078a24, 103 s. Input: Pexels portrait-woman-studio.jpg at 768 px, target word face. Result: 768x1152, 5.9% of the pixels changed, the face is covered by a mosaic and the rest is untouched. One single face only; groups, profiles and masks over small faces are not tested. Receipt: scripts/utility-packs-e2e.mjs.
